name: Save Tongue
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Pour hot water from the thermos onto the frozen pole. Use the stun gun to crack the ice.
Tap the barista to get a hot coffee and melt more ice.
Use the megaphone to shake loose the frost.
Tap the truck exhaust to blow warm air on the pole.
Focus sunlight with the magnifying glass.
Use the hot sausage to warm the frozen spot.
Spread the spicy chili paste on the pole.
Use the heated smartphone to melt the remaining ice.
